title: Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs — Clearing Hold on Credit Refunds
content:
**Clearing hold — Lender-Placed Flood Master Programs, refunds of program credit balances on request.** Tidemark holds back from the refundable credit, without taking it below zero, the whole of the lender payments received in the last month when the program has been in force fewer than 24 months or the program received fewer than 6 lender payments in the last 12 months; half (0.5) of those payments when the program has been in force at least 24 but fewer than 60 months and received 6 or more lender payments in the last 12 months; and nothing when it has been in force 60 months or more and received 6 or more lender payments in the last 12 months.

Months in force for a refund are the whole calendar months from the program effective date to today, a month counting only once its day of the month is reached, and a refund window of the last N months covers every entry dated on a day from which fewer than N such whole months have passed by today. "The last month" is the window of the last 1 month; lender payments are dated by the day received.

| Months in force | Lender payments received in the last 12 months | Held back |
|---|---|---|
| Fewer than 24 | any number | All lender payments received in the last month |
| any | fewer than 6 | All lender payments received in the last month |
| 24 to 59 | 6 or more | Half of the lender payments received in the last month |
| 60 or more | 6 or more | Nothing |

*Hypothetical:* a program in force 30 months, with 11 lender payments in the last 12 months and 4,200.00 dollars of payments received in the last month, holds back 2,100.00 dollars.
